acceptance_target: finished visual realization of the supplied source
limits: Only supplied images in garment and automail were inspected.
Complete sources were inspected before candidate renders.
Matched candidate cameras and conditions support qualitative A/B comparison.
Source cameras are unregistered; no calibrated likeness score or exact dimensional claim.
512-pixel renders and visible grain limit fine-detail and material judgments.
No inference about unseen components, topology, articulation, UVs, rigging, engine readiness, or workflow/model superiority.

reasons: Whole torso and sleeve silhouettes are very similar and share reduced tailoring relative to the source.
B has a more continuous collar-to-body relationship and reduces A's projecting rectangular-tab appearance.
A has more intelligible white edge trim; B introduces fragmented inward slashes and V-like marks that do not consistently explain a folded edge.
A's open gap between upper collar tab and lower lapel and B's ambiguous fold/trim treatment are competing substantial defects.
garment.potential_preference_reversal: Weight collar surface continuity more heavily to prefer B; weight clean pale-edged notch readability more heavily to prefer A.

main_reasons: Flat projecting upper collar tabs and abrupt separation from lower lapels.
Pale/metallic-looking bands instead of the source's dark strap construction.
Simplified emblems, chains, hanging ornaments, shoulder tabs, and fasteners.
Fragmented upper trim and unclear collar/lapel fold relationship.
Retains the shared body, sleeve, strap, and ornament simplifications.

reasons: B's shoulder shell has more continuous formed volume; A shows broad planar faceting.
B's curved forearm cover reads more volumetrically than A's flat slabs.
B's socket lips and stepped rim show stronger layered depth.
B's rounded palm and pads read more like grip surfaces than A's faceted blocks.
automail.potential_preference_reversal: A may be preferred locally for harder mechanical planes; B over-softens some panel language and has swollen-looking palm pads. These tradeoffs do not outweigh B's combined surface-volume advantage.

main_reasons: Coarse faceting of prominent shells and palm.
Simplified straight assembly and limited layered mechanical relationships.
Coarse finger segments and repetitive cylindrical joints.
Sparse armor divisions, rear structure, service-area detail, and material differentiation relative to source.
Broad smooth armor remains sparsely divided and unlike the source's nested panels.
Improved socket depth retains simplified surrounding construction and a conspicuous bright inner lip.
Forearm cover and service plate remain simplified.
Rounded but generic palm pads and unchanged coarse finger construction.
